summary: Backend testing complete for Leanly. All 14 pytest cases passed (100%) across 9 review-request scenarios: health check, targets compute (Mifflin-St Jeor), health-score compute, AI coach message (OpenRouter), meal-plan generate (OpenRouter json_mode), weekly-report (OpenRouter json_mode), food/analyze (OpenAI Vision GPT-4o-mini), Supabase schema verification (7 expected tables present, RLS enabled, profiles columns), and OpenRouter fallback (observed 429 on google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free followed by graceful 200 on next model). Tests hit the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL ingress, so they validate the same path used by the mobile app. No issues found.

minor.issue: When calorie_target=0 and protein_target=0, the calorie adherence helper returns the default 0.5 → 15 points (plus 2 for weight_trend==0), giving score≈17 even for an empty/unconfigured user. Consider returning 0 when targets are not set so the UI gauge starts at zero before onboarding completes.

action_items: Optional: in /api/health-score/compute, treat missing calorie_target as 0 score instead of the 0.5 default to avoid an inflated score for un-onboarded users.

Optional: free-tier OpenRouter models 429 frequently; the fallback works but adds ~1s latency. Consider caching the last successful model index per process or using a paid OpenRouter key for production traffic.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/food/analyze raises HTTPException(422) with message containing prose — fine but Pydantic response_model=FoodAnalyzeRes will swallow extra fields. Acceptable.
server.py: @app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in FastAPI 0.110+ in favor of lifespan handlers, but still functional.
server.py: All endpoints async, no MongoDB usage (despite MONGO_URL in .env). OK for a thin AI proxy.
server.py: No auth on AI endpoints — anyone with the public URL can burn OpenAI/OpenRouter quota. Consider verifying the Supabase JWT in a dependency before forwarding to AI providers.

success_rate.frontend: not tested (frontend testing skipped per request)

seed_data_creation: None. Tests use a public Unsplash food image (downloaded on the fly) for the vision test. No DB writes.

Supabase pooler creds live in test_supabase_schema.py (host aws-1-ap-northeast-1.pooler.supabase.com, user postgres.ghglnlyopnemxxnlomvj). rca_of_issue: No bugs requiring RCA. All endpoints behave per spec. OpenRouter fallback chain confirmed working in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: 'OpenRouter google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free -> 429, falling back' followed by 200 on the next model.
